text: Yes, the cafeteria should introduce the plant-based menu. Firstly, according to Evidence A, the dietitian-reviewed rotation ensures that all nutritional requirements are met, making it safe and reliable for students' health. Secondly, Evidence C highlights seasonal produce contract savings, which will not only reduce costs but also ensure the freshness and quality of ingredients, supporting this decision further. Moreover, as shown in Evidence D, the success of the same menu change at North campus demonstrates the potential for increased demand when implemented thoughtfully. Therefore, introducing the plant-based menu is both necessary and beneficial for maintaining student well-being while potentially lowering operational expenses through cost-saving measures linked to sustainability and affordability.
